init_called_by_unauthorized.meaning: BuilderWallet.init() was invoked by a caller that is not an authorized party

builder_admin_overwritten.meaning: the builderAdmin address storage slot was overwritten by the init() call

attacker_holds_admin.meaning: the attacker address occupies the builderAdmin role after the overwrite

assumptions: init() is externally callable by any address (no caller restriction), per init_lacks_access_control.
The builderAdmin role is the authority that sweep() relies on, per sweep_should_be_admin_only.
The attacker's init() call is the transition that sets builderAdmin to the attacker, per attacker_calls_init.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether init() had already been called or whether builderAdmin was previously set before the attacker's call, so the pre-existing admin value cannot be bound.
Report does not state whether sweep() has its own access control restricting it to builderAdmin; the drain_all_tokens impact is not formalized in this pass.

limitations: Only the admin_takeover impact is formalized; token drain and loss of funds are handled in separate claim-generation passes.
The attacker identity is symbolic; no concrete address is required.
The overwrite relation is encoded as observable booleans because the report gives no numeric or address-valued binding for the prior admin value.
